1_temporal_ordering.basis: Sequence of ED visits, diagnoses across visits, and within-visit vital/Pyxis timestamps.

2_current_vs_historical.basis: Snapshot-basis: medications LISTED on visit N vs NOT_LISTED_LATEST on visit N after appearing on an earlier visit.
2_current_vs_historical.limitation: Snapshot list only; absence from a later list is not proof of clinical discontinuation.

3_longitudinal_change.basis: 117 consecutive visit pairs have medications added or dropped; within-visit vital sign series.

4_irrelevant_history.basis: Multi-visit patients with up to 23 visits and dense vital/medication records around a specific query concept.

5_missing_or_ambiguous_dates.basis: 25 stays of multi-visit patients lack medrecon lists; home medications have no prescription start/end dates (U1/U4 uncertainty).

6_conflicting_information.basis: No explicit active-vs-stopped or dose-conflict records exist in MIMIC-IV-ED demo (medrecon vs pyxis is an informational provenance note per Section 7.5). Fully tested in Track S.

7_insufficient_evidence.basis: Constructed by querying unrecorded medications, labs, or conditions not present in the patient's ED history.
